scope: SCOPED to civil appeal routes, one module. s 21 with the Third Schedule (appeals from the State Courts), s 22(7) (relief for non-appealing parties), s 29 with the Fourth Schedule (non-appealable decisions), s 29A with the Fifth Schedule (permission), s 29C with the Sixth Schedule (Appellate Division or Court of Appeal), and ss 45 and 60C (no automatic stay). Not encoded: Parts 1 and 2, original jurisdiction, the SICC, criminal appeals, Part 5 Division 4 (post-appeal capital applications), Parts 6 and 7 (officers, civil restraint orders, vexatious litigants), s 80 (Rules of Court) and the Seventh, Ninth and Tenth Schedules. The Rules of Court 2021 were not retrieved.
